description: Get recent earthquake reports issued by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) via the P2PQuake network. Returns seismic events with epicenter name, coordinates, depth, Richter magnitude, maximum JMA intensity (Shindo scale 1–7), tsunami advisory status, and per-prefecture/city observation points. Filter by minimum/maximum seismic intensity, magnitude, prefecture (JIS code 1–47), or report type. Sort newest-first (default) or oldest-first. JMA intensity scale: 10=Shindo1, 20=Shindo2, ..., 60=Shindo6w, 65=Shindo6s, 70=Shindo7. Tsunami status: None | Checking | NonEffective | Watch | Warning. Data source: P2PQuake — community-operated JMA relay, open data, no auth required.

limit.description: Number of events to return (default 10, max 100)

max_scale.description: Maximum JMA seismic intensity as raw scale value (same scale as min_scale)

min_magnitude.description: Minimum earthquake magnitude (Richter scale, e.g. 5.0 for moderate earthquakes)

min_scale.description: Minimum JMA seismic intensity as raw scale value (10=Shindo1, 20=Shindo2, 30=Shindo3, 40=Shindo4, 45=Shindo4+, 50=Shindo5w, 55=Shindo5s, 60=Shindo6w, 65=Shindo6s, 70=Shindo7)

order.description: Sort direction: -1 for newest-first (default), 1 for oldest-first

prefecture.description: Filter by Japanese prefecture JIS code (1=Hokkaido, 13=Tokyo, 27=Osaka, 40=Fukuoka, 47=Okinawa)

quake_type.description: JMA report type filter: ScalePrompt=intensity prompt, Destination=epicenter info, DetailScale=full epicenter+intensity report, Foreign=overseas earthquake, Other=miscellaneous

name: p2pquake.seismic.recent_quakes

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Japan Recent Earthquakes
